title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10854__PART_5_)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_10854__PART_5_) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10854__PART_5_). This Indian Standard was adopted by the Inland and Harbour Craft Sectional Committee had been approved by the Transport Engineering Division Council. This standard gives requirements for cutter suction dredge components. This standard has been based on the information supplied by Dredging Corporation of India, Visakhapatnam. This standard is being issued in the following parts: Part 1 Cutter Part 2 Suction pipe Part 3 Ladders Part 4 Spuds \ Part 6 Cast spud cylinder The committee responsible for the preparation of this standard is given at Annex A. In reporting the results of a test or analysis made in accordance with this standard, if the final value, observed or calculated, is to be rounded off, it shall be done in accordance with 'Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised )'. IS 10854 ( Part 5 ) : 1993 Indian Standard INLAND VESSELS— CUTTER SUCTION DREDGE COMPONENTS PART 5 CAST SPUD POINT — GENERAL REQUIREMENTS

marking_requirements: Standard marked products are also continuously checked by BIS for conformity to that standard as a further safeguard.
